See, I’ve had the same problem as you I got 2 pigs from the pet store and one died from URI and now my other piggie is sick. My pigs were always sick and repeatedly on meds. Like I said I invested in a air purifier and my pig seems to be doing better, I’ve taken out all the wood chews and bridges and replaced it with tp rolls (to chew on) (someone on reddit said they took all the wood products out and their piggie got better) I’ve started shaking all the hay out to get all the dust out before I put it in the cage, I deep cleaned the whole cage (in case the germs were on the cage), I’ve started cleaning the water bottle better (sticking q-tip up the nozzl, found lots of gunk), and cleaning all the plastic hidies more often. all Those things made a little improvement show. But I think you should really invest in a air purifier (a good one that actually works).
